A new look you can choose, player fixes and working in-app updates.

### What's new
- **Two styles**: keep the **Liquid Glass** look or switch to **Material You**, with flat tinted surfaces, rounded shapes and Android-style switches and sliders. Pick one in **Settings → Appearance**.
- **Accent colors**: Classic, Ocean, Aurora, Sunset, Mint and Gold, each tuned for both the dark and light theme. On Android 12+ you can also use your **wallpaper colors**.

### Fixed
- **In-app updates**: the version shown in Settings now always matches the release, so the update check no longer keeps offering the version you already have.
- **Resume position**: after reopening the app, playing a different track than the one left paused no longer starts it from the old track's position.
- **Player cover**: skipping tracks quickly no longer leaves the previous track's cover in the player.

### Installation
Update from **Settings → Updates** in the app, or download **ArtistGrid.apk** below. Installs over the previous version and keeps your favorites. Requires Android 6.0+.

> Debug build, not signed for the Play Store.
